name: Randis
summary: In Cathedral Square, Randis waits for a chance to see the world beyond Stormwind. During Children's Week, he eagerly joins willing adventurers across Alliance lands.

sections.title: A Ward of Stormwind
sections.body: Randis lives in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, one of many children left without family by the realm's conflicts. When Children's Week comes each year, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives sympathetic heroes a whistle and entrusts them with his care. Curious and full of questions, Randis dreams of adventure, asks riddles, and declares that he wants to be king of Stormwind when he grows up.

sections.title: Eyes on the World
sections.body: For Randis, who spends most days in Cathedral Square, leaving the capital is a grand adventure. He remarks that places like Ironforge smell odd, and his wonder shows what Alliance heroes fight to protect.

faq.answer: Randis is a human child living at the Stormwind Orphanage in Cathedral Square. During Children's Week, willing adventurers can look after him and take him across Alliance lands.
During Children's Week, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives adventurers an orphan whistle in Cathedral Square. Blow it, and Randis comes along on your travels.

faq.q: What places does Randis want to visit?
faq.answer: Randis wants to visit anywhere beyond Stormwind's walls with the hero who takes him along. He has visited Ironforge and says it smells funny there.

faq.q: Why is Randis living in an orphanage?
faq.answer: Randis lost his parents to the constant wars, invasions, and hardships that have struck Stormwind and the wider lands of Azeroth. Many children under Matron Nightingale's care share that loss.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, caring for Randis during Children's Week reminds you that your battles protect the next generation of civilians and dreamers.
